By way of the present petition filed under section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, the petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 0100/2024 dated 22.01.2024 registered under sections 420/406/120-B/506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: D.B.G. Road, Delhi ('subject FIR').
2.

3. Mr. Kumar states that by reason of the intervening pandemic there were delays and certain other problems with the re-development of the property, which has led to the registration of the subject FIR.
Counsel states that the collaboration agreement also contains an arbitration clause.
4. Mr. Kumar informs the court, that the petitioner is a 65 year old lady, against whom there is no specific allegation except in her capacity as one of the directors of the company.

sentences.text: Issue notice.
6. Mr. Utkarsh, learned APP appears on behalf of the State on advance copy; accepts notice; and seeks time to file status report.
7. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the complainants on advance copy; accepts notice; and seeks time to file reply.
8. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the complainants informs the court that the original documents of the property are in the possession of the petitioner's husband.
9. Let status report/reply be filed within 06 weeks; response/rejoinder, if any, be filed within 03 weeks thereafter; with copies to the opposing counsel.

10. Re-notify on 29th November 2024.
11.

In the meantime, considering the nature of the dispute that has led to the registration of the subject FIR and the fact that the petitioner is a 65 year old lady, subject to the petitioner joining investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer ('I.O.') with written notice This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/08/2024 at 02:47:11 duly served upon her, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner, till the next date of hearing.
12. As requested by the I.O., who is present in court, the petitioner is directed to report to the I.O. at P.S.: D.B.G. Road, Delhi on 17.08.2024 at 04:00 p.m. for purposes of investigation.
